# split

Split input into separate files through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/split -l 100 input.txt part-

moonx cli/split -b 1M input.bin chunk-
```

Split by lines, bytes, record-aware byte limits or chunk selection. Default output is 1,000 lines per file with alphabetic suffixes.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-l VALUE`, `--lines VALUE` | Put this many records in each piece. Default: `1000`. |
| `-b VALUE`, `--bytes VALUE` | put SIZE bytes in each piece |
| `-C VALUE`, `--line-bytes VALUE` | put at most SIZE bytes of records in each piece |
| `-n VALUE`, `--number VALUE` | N, K/N, l/N, l/K/N, r/N or r/K/N |
| `-a VALUE`, `--suffix-length VALUE` | fixed suffix width; zero selects automatic width |
| `--additional-suffix VALUE` | append SUFFIX to generated names |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Existing output files are refused. Size-dependent stdin modes may spool input to temporary storage.
- --filter runs the supported pure MoonBit shell profile; external children still require launcher permission.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
